author: blu
body: Targeting legality: validates whether a permanent or player can be targeted by a spell or ability, accounting for shroud, hexproof, and protection. Also handles target-on-resolution checks (fizzle).

author: blu
body: Protection from a colour lives in a permanent's abilities (ProtectionFrom c), not its keyword set, so protection targeting legality reads the target's abilities against the source spell's colours: a creature with protection from red cannot be targeted by a red spell. (The previous stub always returned False, so protection never blocked targeting at all.)
